description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android TV application. It extends FragmentActivity, sets up the UI using Jetpack Compose with a custom theme, and displays the HomeRoot composable as the main content.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the Android TV app, managing the UI lifecycle and setting up the Compose content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the FragmentActivity's onCreate method to initialize the UI with Compose, applying a dark theme and setting up the HomeRoot composable.
